question: Who was the Prime Minister of India when the Industrial Policy of 1991 was launched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PV Narasimha Rao.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** PV Narasimha Rao** is the** Prime Minister of India** when the Industrial Policy of **1991 **was launched.
 
• The main aim of this policy is to unshackle the Indian industries from the cobweb of unnecessary bureaucratic control.
 
• This policy introduces liberalisation with a view to integrating the Indian economy with the world economy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Industrial policies**

 
 
• Industrial policies were launched in** 1948, 1956,1977,1980 and 1991.**
 
• The** industrial policy resolution of 1948 marked** the beginning of the evolution of the **Indian Industrial Policy.**
 
• The **IPR 1956 **called the **Economic constitution** of India gave the **public sector a strategic role in the economy.**
 
• The objective of the** IPR 1956 **was the establishment of a **socialistic pattern** of the society in the country.
